description: This file contains the implementation of a visitor class for evaluating predicates over 'Thing' objects. It specifically implements logic to generate predicates based on various comparison operations (e.g., equals, not equals, greater than) as part of a query filtering mechanism in the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: ThingPredicatePredicateVisitor
classes.description: A singleton class implementing predicate evaluation logic for 'Thing' objects based on various operators, used for filtering and querying within Eclipse Ditto.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of this visitor class.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Creates a Java Predicate for a 'Thing' from a Ditto query predicate and a field name.

methods.name: visitEq
methods.description: Generates a predicate that checks equality of a field's value against a given value.

methods.name: visitNe
methods.description: Generates a predicate that checks inequality of a field's value against a given value.

methods.name: visitGe
methods.description: Generates a predicate that checks if a field's value is greater than or equal to a given value.

methods.name: visitGt
methods.description: Generates a predicate that checks if a field's value is greater than a given value.

methods.name: visitLe
methods.description: Generates a predicate that checks if a field's value is less than or equal to a given value.

methods.name: visitLt
methods.description: Generates a predicate that checks if a field's value is less than a given value.

methods.name: visitIn
methods.description: Generates a predicate that checks if a field's value is contained within a list of specified values.

methods.name: visitLike
methods.description: Generates a predicate that checks if a string field matches a given regex pattern.

methods.name: getThingField
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified field from a 'Thing' as a JsonValue.

methods.name: mapJsonValueToJava
methods.description: Converts a JsonValue to a corresponding Java object for comparison purposes.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two Comparable objects, with special handling for numeric conversions.

methods.name: asNumber
methods.description: Converts a Comparable to a BigDecimal if it is a Number, for numeric comparisons.
